clue.text: Platform may show disgust following application of pressure

indicators.note: following tells us the word for disgust comes after the pressure letter

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure, the letter applied first
odium is hatred or disgust

explanation.surface: A speaker's stage might reveal revulsion once someone leans on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised stand for a speaker or winner is a synonym of platform.

clue.text: Make a speech count supporting leader of Opposition

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means placed underneath, so the count word sits below the opening letter
the leader of a word is its opening letter, here of Opposition

parts.note: to rate is to count or reckon

explanation.surface: A politician gives an address backing the head of the Opposition party.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to deliver a formal address, often pompously.

clue.text: Popular couple at work

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to harness is to couple or yoke, as horses to a cart

explanation.surface: A well-liked pair are busy on the job together.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means still working, still on duty, like a horse in its traces.

clue.text: Victim in trade centre, unknown Republican

parts.note: a mart is a market, a centre of trade
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: Someone hurt at a shopping centre turns out to be an unnamed Republican.
explanation.definitionFit: One who suffers or dies for a cause is a victim in the strongest sense.

clue.text: Bold disobedience intended after first half of demo

indicators.note: after places the intended partner behind the half of demo
takes the opening two of the four letters of demo

parts.note: one's intended is one's fiance

explanation.surface: A protester's open defiance follows the start of a demonstration on purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Open refusal to obey is exactly bold disobedience.

clue.text: Entirely because of article on stadium

parts.note: if something is down to you, it is because of you
the is the definite article
a ground is a sports stadium

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about a sports stadium explains the cause of something.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom suits me down to the ground means completely, so it is a synonym of entirely.

clue.text: Match found about convict's body

indicators.note: about means going around, so the match word wraps the convict

parts.note: a fusee is a large-headed match that stays lit in wind
a lag is slang for a convict; the 's is a link to the definition

explanation.surface: A lighted match is discovered near a prisoner's corpse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'body' looks like a corpse; it is the main body of an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: The main cabin structure of an aircraft is its body.

clue.text: A chopped pungent savoury jelly

indicators.note: chopped means cut short, so the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: spicy means hot and pungent

explanation.surface: Something minced with sharp seasoning set in a meaty jelly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopped' removes Y from SPICY to leave SPIC.
explanation.definitionFit: This clear jelly made from meat stock is a classic savoury glaze.

clue.text: Lookout cross, went mad

indicators.note: mad means crazed, so the letters of these words go wild and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sentry, angry, lost his temper completely.
explanation.definitionFit: The platform high on a ship's mast is where a lookout keeps watch, and names the lookout post itself.

clue.text: Has former PM tucked into hot South American breakfast dish?

indicators.note: tucked into means placed inside, so the PM goes between the hot and South letters

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
Gordon Brown was UK Prime Minister 2007-10

explanation.surface: A retired prime minister eats a spicy Latin American breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'South American' reads as one phrase; split it so South gives S and American starts the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Fried grated potato cakes are a staple of the American diner breakfast.

clue.text: Power line in front part of ship

parts.note: a row is a line

explanation.surface: Electric cables run in the bow of a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: The pointed forward end of a vessel is its bow.

clue.text: Play part storing renewable energy?

indicators.note: storing means holding inside, so the part letters hold the other letters
renewable suggests the letters are made anew, rearranged

explanation.surface: A component that holds green power for later use.
explanation.walkthrough: PT holds EERGYN, the reworking of ENERGY that 'renewable' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibsen's verse drama of 1867, set to music by Grieg, is a famous play.

clue.text: Insect discovered in place close to desert

parts.note: a locus is a place or position

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter, here of desert

explanation.surface: A bug found somewhere near the edge of the desert.
explanation.definitionFit: A swarming grasshopper of hot regions is one kind of insect.

clue.text: Mother joining Church of England staff

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: A mum becomes an Anglican employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' looks like employees; it is a ceremonial rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremonial club carried as a symbol of office is a kind of staff.

clue.text: Together years ago?

definitions.meaning: all happening simultaneously, in a single moment

explanation.surface: Were we a couple long ago?
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both simultaneously and formerly, matching each definition.

clue.text: Side by side, move backwards secured by rope

indicators.note: secured by means held within, so the rope word encloses the move word

parts.note: a tether is a rope tying an animal

indicators.note: backwards means the move word is read in reverse

parts.note: to go is to move

explanation.surface: Two climbers roped together retreat down the slope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rope' doubles as a verb in the surface, but here it is the noun for a tie, and 'move' is the verb go.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alongside one another is a close synonym of being in company.

clue.text: Actor bad at reading

indicators.note: bad suggests these letters are spoiled and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A performer who cannot read his lines well.
explanation.definitionFit: A player who specialises in tragic roles is a type of actor.

clue.text: Mike installed inside carriage for broadcast

indicators.note: installed inside means put within the carriage word

parts.note: transit is the carrying or carriage of goods
Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A microphone fitted in a vehicle for a radio show.
explanation.definitionFit: To send out a signal over the air is to broadcast it.

clue.text: Make sense of arguments against? Correct

parts.note: cons are arguments against, as in pros and cons
true means correct

explanation.surface: Can you follow the opposing case? It's right.
explanation.definitionFit: To interpret or understand a statement is to make sense of it.

clue.text: Stake needed, unlimited

indicators.note: unlimited means without its limits, so the first and last letters go

parts.note: wanted means needed

explanation.surface: A gambler's bet must be put down, with no cap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needed' is WANTED, and 'unlimited' strips its outer letters W and D.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker, the stake each player puts up before the deal is a stake.

clue.text: One failing to attend meal — ring wife

parts.note: nosh is British slang for food or a meal
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: An absentee skips dinner, so phone the wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who books but never turns up is a noted absentee.

clue.text: Fewer working class

parts.note: less means fewer
on means working, as a machine switched on

explanation.surface: A smaller labouring class in society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working class' reads as one phrase; split it so class is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A school period of teaching is a class.

clue.text: Bar stocking old Italian wine

indicators.note: stocking means holding as stock inside, so the bar word holds the letter

parts.note: save means bar, except

explanation.surface: A pub keeps a vintage Italian bottle in stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' looks like a pub; it means except.
explanation.definitionFit: This dry white from the Veneto is a well-known Italian wine.

clue.text: So I heard broadcast where Ian Smith was premier

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A news report on where a particular politician once led.
explanation.definitionFit: Ian Smith led the white-minority government of this former African state, now Zimbabwe.

clue.text: At home aggressive dog may make one suffer

parts.note: in means at home
a cur is a snappish, aggressive mongrel

explanation.surface: A vicious dog in the house may cause someone pain.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring something unpleasant upon oneself, such as costs, is to suffer it.

clue.text: Permit is required to enter Virginia

indicators.note: to enter means going inside, so the word is sits within the state abbreviation

explanation.surface: A travel permit is needed to get into a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: An official endorsement allowing entry to a country is a permit.

clue.text: Spokesperson's opening snippet

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition to wordplay

parts.note: a mouth is an opening
a piece is a snippet or fragment

explanation.surface: A spokesman's first remark is just a soundbite.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who speaks on behalf of others is called this, informally.

clue.text: Frequent red tape involved crossing Spain

indicators.note: crossing means straddling, so the mixed letters go around the Spain letter
involved means tangled, so the letters of red tape are mixed

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Endless bureaucracy is tangled up across Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges RED TAPE, which wraps around E.
explanation.definitionFit: Happening again and again is a synonym of frequent.

clue.text: Go by land that's bleak

indicators.note: by means next to, so the go word sits beside the land word

parts.note: to land a prize is to win it
a go is a try or attempt

explanation.surface: Travel overland, which is dreary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'land' looks like terrain; it is the verb meaning secure.
explanation.definitionFit: Cold, snowy weather is wintry and so bleak.
